english.note: Use this neutral construction when N is simply identified by the name A, without implying that the name is false or unsuitable.

examples.english: This little shop, so-called “Granny Tofu Pudding,” is packed every morning.
examples.traditional: 呢間叫做「阿婆豆腐花」嘅小店，朝早成日坐滿人。
